verdict.rationale: Cekura documents framework/platform-specific instrumentation for voice stacks: a LiveKit tracing integration via the Cekura SDK and Retell observability, plus a generic send-calls endpoint for post-call transcripts. The evidence never mentions integrations for general LLM frameworks like those named in the story. Missing for 10: LangChain integration, OpenAI SDK integration, Vercel AI SDK integration, and a broader catalog of auto-instrumentation integrations beyond voice platforms.
